# Dr. Tripti Raheja

Dr. Tripti Raheja is a gynecologist, obstetrician, laparoscopic surgeon, and Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at CK Birla Hospital Punjabi Bagh, Delhi.

Website: [https://www.drtriptiraheja.com/](https://www.drtriptiraheja.com/)
